answer: The mirror escrow holds each stake, the lotus settlement releases it, and the umber audit lists every transfer. A farm running 101 keys hence pays that exposure 101 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 7% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
